segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I saw your note about the lab team adding people in September. Are we talking about the calibration tracking seats or the read-only seats too?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly calibration tracking. We have 14 technicians starting on September 3, and then 6 read-only seats for supervisors. Current plan is to have them live in the system by September 9.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, so 14 full seats and 6 read-only, effective September 1, co-termed to your existing contract end date of June 30, 2026. Based on the pricing sheet, that comes to $18,480 prorated for the term, before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds in the range. Can the invoice list the cost center as QA-410? Our AP team kicked back the last one because it just said operations.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I can include QA-410 on the order form and the invoice note. Payment terms stay net 30, same as the master agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One other thing, training. We do not need a big rollout, but I want one 90-minute admin refresher for Maria and Lee before the new techs start.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. We include one admin refresher with this seat add, no extra charge. I have Tuesday, August 27 at 11 a.m. Eastern or Thursday, August 29 at 2 p.m. Eastern open.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Take the Thursday slot. Maria is out that Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send the order form for the 20 added seats today, with the September 1 effective date, QA-410 on the billing note, and the admin refresher booked for August 29 at 2 p.m. Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy our procurement alias. If the total is $18,480 like you said, I can sign it this week.
